name: limit_dimension_that_will_not_leave_the_fillet_alone
why: Two fillets of 8 on the edges at the top, then the thickness brought to 6: the fillet no longer fits. SOLIDWORKS DOES NOT FAIL — it rebuilds clean, zero features in error, and changes the shape by itself (measured with the bench probe `prova0089 storia`, 26/9/2026). The only sign is that the base extrusion loses two whole faces (6 -> 4): the sides are taken by the fillets. It is the mechanism of case r05 of the regression, the last of the silences. `set_dimension` must refuse, say WHICH fillet, and put back the previous value.

expect.tolerance_why: 120000 minus 2 x (1 - pi/4) x 8^2 x 100 = 2746.9: the calculation has pi inside
